name: micro-1c8b82b3-blind16-ots
instr:
# micro: repairing a terminal text editor that mangles typing, clicks and replacements, without a test suite

Everyday editing in this build goes wrong in a lot of small, independent ways, and the damage is scattered widely enough that fixing one thing does not make the next thing work. The repository has received 16 separate undocumented edits.

Getting a file onto the screen is already unreliable once anything else is open. Asking for a file by its path decides which of the things already open belongs to that path by exactly the wrong test, so afterwards nothing on screen is associated with the path asked for, and what comes up is unrelated to what was requested.

Typing then misbehaves. In the ordinary mode, a run of plain characters overwrites the characters sitting under the insertion point rather than pushing them along, and the mode that is supposed to type over them pushes them along instead, so a short insertion eats an equal number of characters to its right. Some plain keystrokes never reach the text at all, as though a general catch-all key binding were being applied when it should not be, or skipped when it should apply. The key that removes the character before the insertion point, pressed in ordinary non-blank text, takes out a whole tab's worth of characters in one press, while a press in leading whitespace removes just one.
